mr_title: Fix assertion rewriting with importlib mode

expected_issues.title: Extra module path given to all finders resolves the wrong module
expected_issues.description:
Passing module_path as an extra search path to every meta-path finder makes find_spec resolve the wrong object when a package directory contains a module with the same name (pkg/moo/moo.py), causing ImportError in importlib mode.

The search path list is used by all finders in sys.meta_path, not only by the assertion rewriter. When loading the parent package `cow.moo`, PathFinder searching in `/cow/moo` finds `/cow/moo/moo.py` and returns a module instead of the namespace package; the child `cow.moo.moo` is then resolved as a namespace. The extra path should only be given to the assertion-rewrite hook and only for files.
